description: This file defines the NotFoundException class within the SuiteCRM exception handling system. It extends a base Exception class and provides a constructor that prepends '[Not Found]' to its message, with a default error code.

classes.name: NotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception class representing not found errors, extending the base Exception class and customizing its message and code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a NotFoundException, prepending '[Not Found]' to the message and setting a default error code.
